summary: legal checked in 3 executive handoff item(s)

items.summary: Risk disposition: blocked for bounded public beta or full launch; conditional for continued private preview. Retain searchwoot.com as private. Woot documentation confirms API access and rate limits but not rights to store, derive, cache, display, alert on, or monetize data. Privacy, consent, security, accuracy, attribution, correction, takedown, and rollback evidence remain unresolved. Human counsel is required for source rights, privacy scope, disclosures, copyright/trademark, platform policy, and any regulated or age-sensitive use.

Launch-readiness tracking remains active. Progress: 0 of 4 legal tasks evidenced closed; all remain open. Non-legal accuracy/freshness, measurement/attribution, and security/release gates remain blocked. Next evidence action: attach the current authoritative Woot agreement or written permission, field-level provenance, permitted storage/display/alert and monetization uses, attribution requirements, freshness limits, and correction/takedown process to searchwoot-legal-source-rights.

Data-use dispositions: Woot API deal and price-history data = evidence_needed; missing rights, provenance, freshness, correction, takedown, image, trademark, pricing, savings-claim, alert, affiliate, and advertising evidence. User alert rules and sync results = evidence_needed; missing data-flow, retention, deletion, access/correction, processor, consent, and unsubscribe evidence. GA4 analytics = evidence_needed; missing deployed consent/withdrawal, property settings, retention, vendor disclosure, and jurisdiction evidence. Operational logs and Cloudflare hosting data = evidence_needed; missing log fields, retention/access controls, vendor terms or DPA review, and incident/request procedures. Smallest next actions are respectively a rights inventory, read-only data-flow table, consent/configuration capture, and operator/vendor inventory.
